scope: Broaden the pre-R2018 MTEXT XDATA review to 1005 handle semantics, linked-column targets, and the separate text-frame XDATA route; update existing PAR-19/7K readiness.

method.kind: Official DXF reference, open-source peer source/documentation, local source audit, and generated ASCII/binary control
generatedProfiles: pre-R2018 ACAD_MTEXT_COLUMN_INFO, ACAD_MTEXT_COLUMNS, and ACAD_MTEXT_DEFINED_HEIGHT XDATA
linked MTEXT targets preallocated before source and replay output
forced output handle-allocation gap on replay
unknown typed XDATA key retained in order
separate linked entities with an interleaved LINE
localInspection: src/libdxfrw.cpp: generic XDATA 1005 remapping, source identity map, and preallocateEntityHandle
dwg2dxf/dx_iface.cpp and dwg2dxf/dx_iface.h: specific known-link preplanning; no generic app-defined XDATA endpoint scan
tests/dxf_fixture_tests.cpp: generated pre-R2018 linked-column XDATA source, handle plan, and read/write/read assertions
DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md: PAR-19/7K, 7E, and existing XDATA graph/atomic writer owners
method.limitations: Autodesk documents group-1005 identity behavior but not the MTEXT-specific legacy column or text-frame XDATA subkey grammar. ezdxf's frame grammar is peer documentation and it deliberately removes that legacy frame profile during its second load stage. No native CAD application, independent DWG/DXF parser runtime, frame producer file, or semantic column aggregation was tested.

evidence.observed: Group 1005 stores an entity database handle and is translated with the referenced entity during documented drawing merge operations. Autodesk says AUDIT considers a handle that matches no entity an error.
doesNotEstablish: the MTEXT-specific ACAD_MTEXT_COLUMNS or ACAD_MTEXT_TEXT_BORDERS grammar
that arbitrary app-defined XDATA endpoints can be discovered from raw text alone
evidence.planUse: Keep 1005 values linked to output identities when those endpoints are known; do not silently publish stale handles after identity changes.

evidence.topic: ezdxf legacy MTEXT profiles and resource mapping
evidence.observed: The MTEXT internals describe distinct legacy linked-column XDATA and text-frame XDATA profiles. The latter may point to separate LWPOLYLINE frame entities. The docs say ezdxf does not create that frame graph and removes it during second-stage loading. Its resource-mapping source maps XDATA group 1005 as a soft-pointer handle.
doesNotEstablish: an Autodesk-authoritative schema for all legacy subkeys
raw MTEXT frame-XDATA preservation by ezdxf
evidence.planUse: Distinguish exact XDATA bracket scopes; do not conflate frame polylines with linked MTEXT columns or use ezdxf's normalized model as a raw-preservation oracle.

evidence.observed: Generic XDATA 1005 serialization remaps through the source-to-emitted identity map. Forward targets need preallocation or a resolver. The generic writer does not infer target membership for arbitrary app-defined XDATA.
doesNotEstablish: a general safe auto-resolution policy for arbitrary 1005 values
handling of missing, duplicated, excluded, or cross-owner graph targets
evidence.planUse: Use explicit preallocation in generated graph tests and require future typed graph writers to preflight known endpoints before publication.

evidence.observed: The strict test target builds and the focused MTEXT column selector passes. The generated test reserves linked target identities before source and replay emission, forces a new handle allocation on replay, then verifies exact XDATA order and references to the separately emitted linked MTEXT entities around an interleaved LINE.
doesNotEstablish: semantic reconstruction or aggregation of columns
evidence.planUse: Retain as a fast identity-preservation control under existing PAR-19/7K.

readinessRefinement: Distinguish pre-R2018 column-link XDATA, candidate text-frame XDATA, and standalone R2018 embedded-object syntax by exact host/bracket scope.

For generated files with known linked endpoints, preallocate target source handles before writing any forward-reference owner, and assert the 1005 output matches the emitted entity handle after a forced identity change.
For future semantic graph output, preflight unique in-scope targets and fail atomically on unresolved or ambiguous endpoints rather than emitting stale handles.
Keep MTEXT column count/list semantics and separate text-frame LWPOLYLINE links independent; do not merge entity callbacks without a qualified consumer contract.
Use only the touched strict test target and focused generated selector per slice; schedule native/peer checks at the composed gate.

commands.notes: ASCII and binary paths pass. Four expected parser diagnostics are emitted by malformed R2018 controls in the same selector.
